name: The Holy Nation
description: A vast theocracy of humans, ruled by a Phoenix believed to be the reborn first ruler, and said to be over five thousand years old. Its people are zealous farmers who worship Okran and live by the Holy Flame. They hate Skeletons as agents of Narko, hold Shek and Hivers in contempt, keep women subservient, and send prisoners to labor at Rebirth.
